read_permissions.Event: Only original Event file, mapped by meta.xml, including site keys, island, habitat, calendar year and sampleSizeValue; this is response-independent geometry/effort qualification
read_permissions.Occurrence: READ ZERO ROWS, no species/taxon/establishment/cover fields

sample_area_expected: 100 square meters; publish author source unit, warn or STOP if non-100 numeric plot-size declaration
failure_policy: Any source hash mismatch, unknown habitat, ID duplicate, bad plot counts, or malformed source Event ends this version; no outcome/taxon read or rescuing categories by inspecting plant compositions
publication_discrepancy: Author IPT publisher metadata states 90 Event/1150 Occurrence, method-step paragraph says 105 Event; the frozen authoritative Event universe is exactly 90
